name: Zedran
fantasy: The wrecking ball. Burns hotter with every hit, chains you in, and finishes it.

card.loop: Melee bruiser: get in, chain them close, and finish the wounded.
card.dash: Three charges of a short dash attack the way you face. Its tip hits twice as hard.
card.passive: Damage fills Rage. Full, you're Enraged: more damage, faster dashes and cooldowns. Knocks heal you.
card.ult: Guard for 0.65s, taking nothing, then lunge into a cleave that heals you; a knock with it resets it.
card.rmb: Tap: a heavy slam, harder on the wounded; a knock after its sweet spot resets your ultimate. Hold: charge, then fling yourself forward. In the air: slam down at your cursor.
card.e: Throw a chain at a foe or a wall. Press E again to pull yourself to it.

weapons.greatsword: Wide slashes, double at the tip. Hold to throw a Searing Wave.

passive.name: Rage
passive.desc: Damage you deal fills Rage (a Searing Wave fills it three times as fast); it cools after 3s out of a fight. Full, you're Enraged for 6s: +15% damage, +12% dash recharge and +20% cooldown speed, with the red shell and the hunter swelling. Knocking a hunter heals you 20% of their health (killing a monster, 20% of its).

dash.name: Rampage
dash.desc: A 3.6m dash attack the way you face (3 charges): 7 to foes along it; the tip at its end hits twice as hard, 14 and a big knock (stun 0.8 into a wall). A knock gives a charge back.

variants.tap: Finishing Slam: a 0.6s wind-up you aim freely (everyone sees the strike lane), then a 4m strike ahead: 26 and push 6; foes under 35% (outlined in red while the Smash is ready) take +50%. Its sweet spot is the far tip, dead ahead: knock a hunter within 2s of hitting them there and the Gilded Riposte is ready again.
variants.hold: Lunge: a crouched wind-up (the lane grows ahead of you, magenta and flashing at full, 0.8s), then release to fling yourself 4.5 -> 7.5m forward into the first foe: 14 -> 20. You can jump while you charge. Strike nothing and the cooldown doubles.
variants.air: Meteor Drop: a disc shows under your cursor (5m at most); you dive onto it, a 2.6m burst: 18 and slow 40% for 1.5s; the centre (1.2m) takes +50% and is stunned 0.8.
variants.during_e: With the Warchain: tap while it pulls you for a Cinder Spin (2.6m, 18, blights 4s); hold while it pulls you, or hold and then pull, for a Haul Slam where you arrive (2.8m, 16 -> 30, stun 0.25 -> 0.6); hold while it's attached and let go for a Chain Lunge along it (x1.25 and a short stun).

e.name: Warchain
e.desc: Throw a chain 10m: it hooks the first foe (8 damage, blighted while tethered: healing barely takes) or bites a wall, for 4s. Press E again to pull yourself to it. The cooldown starts when you pull or the chain breaks (a stun breaks it); you can't throw it while rooted or grounded.

r.name: Gilded Riposte
r.desc: Plant in a gold guard for 0.65s: nothing hurts or stuns you, and each hit you block (two at most) makes the answer 20% harder. Then you lunge 1.8m and cleave up through the 1.8m x 3.6m strip ahead (everyone sees it through the guard): 34, and you heal 80% of what it deals (less while blighted). Knock a hunter with it and it is ready again at once.

rank3.kin: hooking a foe refunds 33% of the cooldown

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 2s -> 1.6s, damage +30%; +20% damage on every Smash.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 9.5s -> 7.6s, damage +30%; hooking a foe refunds 33% of the cooldown.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 9s -> 6.3s; the tip hits +25% harder.

tells.half: red heat glowing through the pauldrons as Rage fills, steam from half
tells.full: Enraged: a red shell, the hunter swells, a roar within 25m; a magenta strike lane while a Smash winds up; a red outline on anyone wounded enough to finish; a gold glow and a white strip ahead of him while he guards
